hard_gates.label: Gemini 3.5 or newer is used through Gemini API or Vertex AI
At least one Google agent framework is present
At least one Google Cloud infrastructure service is built and deployment is proven
The project clearly fits one official track
README contains reproducible local and cloud-oriented spin-up instructions
A clear architecture diagram is ready for judges
A tight unedited approximately four-minute demo proves the product and cloud runtime
Cloud Run, logs, persistent state and a real Gemini call are visibly proven

criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: The patient-owned continuity problem is strong and differentiated, with consent-bound proactive logic and device ingestion. The current visible product still needs one agent-driven closed loop that executes tools and reaches a verified outcome with little hand-holding.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: Typed state, deterministic safety, consent, auditability, ADK, Gemini, Firestore boundary and a clean frontend are strong. The ADK graph is not yet the main runtime, durable cloud execution is absent, identity isolation is incomplete and judge-visible observability is limited.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: The repository, local launcher, synthetic path and setup documentation are useful. There is no completed four-minute judge video, hosted proof, Cloud Run evidence, durable mission trace or final submission package yet.

critical_blockers.statement: The Google ADK coordinator must select and execute the same tools used by the visible chat and proactive workflow.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: One correlated trace showing trigger, ADK decision, tool calls, public results and closure.

critical_blockers.statement: The current process-local loop is not durable asynchronous Google Cloud execution.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub or Cloud Tasks invoking a Cloud Run worker, with logs and retry behavior.

critical_blockers.statement: The product must prove an action completed from event to verified mission outcome, not only generate a message.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: A synthetic end-to-end mission with evidence IDs, action result, patient feedback and closure state.

critical_blockers.statement: The submission lacks visible proof of Cloud Run, persistent state and a real Gemini execution.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Hosted URL or deployment evidence, Cloud Run revision, correlated logs, Firestore round trip and model call.

critical_blockers.statement: The final architecture diagram, unedited demo, write-up and submission evidence are not assembled.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Final judge package matching the official submission checklist.

next_actions: Make Google ADK the visible mission runtime and emit structured public tool results.
Add durable Cloud Scheduler or Pub/Sub execution on Cloud Run with Firestore and Secret Manager.
Record one closed-loop synthetic mission and expose its judge-visible execution timeline.
